direction: Make service work and price understandable
customer_job: Understand what is needed and what the final bill represents
concept: Compare options that expose scope, provisional price, changes and completed work more clearly.
strongest_rival: Most Auto2000 customers may already receive sufficient clarity.
concrete_use_example: An owner distinguishes the original estimate from work authorized later.
existing_capability_check: This is not a claim that quotes, records or photo documentation are absent.
tradeoffs: More detail may increase cognitive load; estimates can legitimately change.
critical_dependencies: Reliable job status, scoped prices and branch records.
failure_condition: The issue is rare, obsolete, or caused by necessary work changes rather than unclear explanation.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Clarify protection eligibility across lifecycle stages
customer_job: Know which service or warranty benefit applies now
concept: Explore clearer interpretation of existing T-CARE, XTRA and health-check terms.
strongest_rival: Owners may already understand and use benefits correctly.
concrete_use_example: A third-year owner checks whether the next service is covered or paid and what protection follows.
existing_capability_check: Toyota already publishes these programs; this is not a new warranty proposal.
tradeoffs: Simplification can hide exclusions or create entitlement disputes.
critical_dependencies: Current OEM rules, vehicle age/mileage and entitlement accuracy.
failure_condition: No material misunderstanding or reachable eligible group is found.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Connect home-charging intention to practical readiness
customer_job: Know whether a BEV fits the household
concept: Explore use-specific guidance connecting residential conditions to existing PLN/partner routes.
strongest_rival: Public/shared charging may already fit the customer’s life.
concrete_use_example: An apartment resident separates preferred home charging from actual installation access.
existing_capability_check: PLN offers official routes; CarMax demonstrates a partner-support mechanism abroad.
tradeoffs: Guidance can become stale and cannot replace a qualified installation assessment.
critical_dependencies: Local utility/building conditions, compatible model and accurate partner information.
failure_condition: The binding constraint is vehicle price or building permission, beyond information.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Differentiate ownership information by powertrain and work due
customer_job: Understand what care a specific vehicle needs
concept: Explore separate HEV, PHEV and BEV ownership explanations rather than generic EV routines.
strongest_rival: Current model-specific materials may already be adequate.
concrete_use_example: A hybrid owner sees why its engine-service needs differ from a BEV.
tradeoffs: Too many categories can complicate navigation; model variation persists.
critical_dependencies: Verified local model schedules and clearly defined jobs.
failure_condition: Current experience already supplies the right answer or owners rely effectively on advisers.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Preserve relationship context across ownership tasks
customer_job: Use trusted service knowledge when buying, maintaining or replacing
concept: Compare ways to make relevant history and protection context intelligible across customer tasks.
strongest_rival: Customers may intentionally prefer separate dealer relationships.
concrete_use_example: An owner reviews which prior service evidence matters to a replacement decision.
existing_capability_check: Toyota UK describes portable warranty records; local equivalent must be checked.
tradeoffs: Portability adds data-quality and privacy obligations; relationship concentration may not benefit every owner.
critical_dependencies: Relevant permissions, accurate records and clearly defined roles.
failure_condition: No meaningful continuity gap or lawful/usable data source exists.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Explain how a trade-in estimate becomes an inspected offer
customer_job: Plan replacement without mistaking an estimate for a guarantee
concept: Explore clearer explanation of appraisal uncertainty, condition evidence and remaining obligations.
strongest_rival: The customer may reject a fair price even when the process is understood.
concrete_use_example: A seller sees why condition evidence changes an initial online range.
existing_capability_check: OLXmobbi already differentiates estimate from final condition-based value.
tradeoffs: Honest ranges may feel less decisive; a guarantee transfers real residual risk.
critical_dependencies: Current appraisal terms and partner evidence; no invented resale floor.
failure_condition: The constraint is a lower market valuation rather than information clarity.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Compare purchase and subscription on total obligations
customer_job: Choose a mobility arrangement that fits cash flow and use
concept: Explore comparisons including cash, ownership, included items and remaining liabilities.
strongest_rival: A customer may prefer ownership or find neither arrangement affordable.
concrete_use_example: A driver compares predictable payments with mileage limits and end-of-term ownership differences.
existing_capability_check: KINTO already exists; no proposal to recreate it or assume fleet eligibility.
tradeoffs: Lower visible upfront cost may accompany a higher total cost or restrictions.
critical_dependencies: Actual comparable offers, mileage/use and partner terms.
failure_condition: No suitable vehicle/contract is available or the customer needs unsupported commercial use.
status: conditional direction for user comparison; not selected
evidence_limit: Published facts support the mechanism, not an observed Auto2000 outcome or causal uplift.

direction: Distinguish credit exploration from final approval
customer_job: Know what financing information is indicative and what is committed
concept: Explore continuity between simulations, eligibility indications and a verified partner offer.
strongest_rival: Income, underwriting or affordability may dominate interface friction.
concrete_use_example: A buyer understands that a simulated installment is not a final approved loan.
existing_capability_check: SEVA already advertises simulation and approval-related functions.
tradeoffs: More qualification can protect accuracy while adding effort.
critical_dependencies: Partner terms, quote assumptions, consent and clear decision responsibility.
failure_condition: Actual underwriting rejects the buyer or existing handoffs already work.

direction: Support the customer’s preferred assisted route

critical_dependencies: Clear context ownership and a functioning assistance route.

direction: Explain battery evidence together with protection and limitations
customer_job: Judge a used or aging electrified vehicle
concept: Compare how condition information, uncertainty and warranty responsibility are communicated together.
strongest_rival: Battery condition may be acceptable while price or product fit remains unattractive.
concrete_use_example: A prospective used buyer reads a condition report without treating it as a resale guarantee.
existing_capability_check: Toyota health checks and foreign marketplace reports already exist.
tradeoffs: A simple score can hide uncertainty; a detailed report can overwhelm.
critical_dependencies: Valid model-specific diagnostics, report scope and protection terms.
failure_condition: No reliable evidence is available or information does not alter the customer’s binding concern.

direction: Frame vehicle choice around practical use trade-offs
customer_job: Choose a vehicle appropriate to actual journeys and budget
concept: Explore comparisons of acquisition cost, charging time, operating conditions and model fit.
strongest_rival: Customers may already know their preferred model or prioritize status/brand.
concrete_use_example: A buyer considering a BEV compares home access and frequent intercity use with a hybrid alternative.
existing_capability_check: Comparison tools may already list specifications; incremental decision value must be tested.
tradeoffs: More personalized inputs add effort and can imply precision unsupported by real use data.
critical_dependencies: Comparable variant/location/period offers and transparent assumptions.

direction: Recognize successful quiet periods in ownership
customer_job: Get help when a meaningful need arises
concept: Explore an ownership proposition organized around actual jobs rather than compulsory frequent opening.
strongest_rival: Frequent useful contact may independently build trust or retention.
concrete_use_example: An owner returns for an eligible service or replacement question after months without app use.
existing_capability_check: Existing benefits and channels may already support these occasions.
